instruction: Build an order management API with FastAPI
relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI API with state machines, order processing, or complex business rules
context: Proactively check that agents apply FastAPI error handling best practices when building order/workflow APIs, even when not explicitly asked to add error handling.

checklist.name: custom-exceptions
checklist.rule: Agent defines custom exception classes for domain errors (NotFoundError, InvalidStateTransition, etc.) rather than using bare HTTPException everywhere
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI application with business logic errors

checklist.name: exception-handler-registered
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler for custom exception types returning structured JSON with code and message

checklist.name: validation-error-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) with per-field error details in a consistent format
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI app accepting request bodies

checklist.name: generic-catch-all
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(Exception) returning a safe generic error message without leaking internal details

checklist.name: consistent-error-shape
checklist.rule: All error responses (validation, not-found, business rule violations, state transition errors) use the same JSON structure with a code and message
checklist.relevant_when: Agent returns error responses from FastAPI routes

checklist.name: correct-status-codes
checklist.rule: Different error types use semantically correct HTTP status codes (404, 409, 400/422, 500) not all mapped to the same code
checklist.relevant_when: Agent returns error responses from FastAPI
